charsheet: Signal Nomad: skinny desert nomad mid-40s, off-white galabia, one all-teal tagelmust wrapping crown and lower face, round silver goggles up on the wrap, weathered brown leather pack with brass radio box (single amber pilot light), copper antenna staff; Static: female dromedary, sandy coat, woven indigo saddle blanket, no halter lead.

beats.locks: zero people, zero animals, zero rope
beats.scene: extreme close-up of a cracked salt crust with a worn leather trekking boot pressing into it, boot toe only

beats.locks: both face and walk toward the right edge; no rope or tether anywhere
beats.scene: man and camel walking side by side across a wide salt flat under a pale morning sky

beats.locks: exactly one man, zero camels, zero rope; brightness stays constant from first frame to last
beats.scene: the nomad kneels at a small brass radio on salt crust, adjusting one dial, calm dusk light
